attchmntText: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Press Release pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulation s, 2015".
voiceSummary: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated total income for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 stood at 39.19 crore rupees, representing a 60.61 percent year-on-year increase. Profit after tax for the quarter was 3.68 crore rupees, up 369.34 percent quarter-on-quarter. For the first half of fiscal year 2027, total income reached 70.77 crore rupees, a 65.29 percent year-on-year rise. Profit after tax for the half year was 4.46 crore rupees. The company also secured a strategic mandate from the Government of Assam to build and manage the state’s official digital content platform. Managing Director Mautik Ajit Tolia signed the filing on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited confirms that the Statement of Deviation or Variation under Regulation 32 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015 is not applicable for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company states there have been no deviations or variations in the use of proceeds raised from the Preferential Issue. This information is filed with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The announcement was signed by Mautik Ajit Tolia, Managing Director, with DIN 06586383, on 14th November 2026.

attchmntText: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The Board approved increasing authorized share capital from Rs. 18,50,00,000 to Rs. 38,00,00,000, subject to shareholder approval. The Board also approved creating mortgages, pledges, charges, and hypothecation over assets to secure borrowings up to Rs. 200 Crores, subject to shareholder approval. An Extra-Ordinary General Meeting will be convened via video conferencing to seek member approval for these matters. For the half year ended 30th September, 2026, standalone revenue from operations was Rs. 1,676.91 Lakhs, and net profit was Rs. 228.46 Lakhs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 0.13. The meeting was held on 14th November, 2026.

attchmntText: Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Extraordinary General Meeting held on October 28, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
